name: calc_percentage_change
description:
Percentage change from an old value to a new value: (new - old) / |old| * 100. Computed locally in Python; no API key or network.
Returns {old_value, new_value, percentage_change} (4 decimals; 0 when old_value is 0).
Inputs (* required): old_value*, new_value* (numbers).
Example: {"old_value": 80, "new_value": 92}
